title: Vanilla Fixes
description: Adds reverse crafting for Nether Wart Blocks and introduces custom early-game advancements for better Minecraft progression.
body:
This datapack adds quality-of-life crafting and revamped advancements to Minecraft.

It allows Nether Wart Blocks to be crafted back into Nether Wart, restoring a useful reverse crafting recipe that is missing in vanilla.

It also adds custom advancements for early-game progression, including:

Getting Wood – Obtain an oak log
Time to Mine – Craft a wooden pickaxe
Time to Strike – Craft a wooden sword
Time to Chop – Craft a wooden axe
Time to Farm – Craft a wooden hoe
Time to Dig – Craft a wooden shovel
Benchmarking – Craft a crafting table
Hot Topic – Craft a furnace
Super Smelter – Craft a blast furnace

These advancements help guide new players through early progression in a more structured and rewarding way. [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/vanilla-fixes/)
